title: Add Cursor Cloud environment setup instructions to AGENTS.md
body: - Add `## Cursor Cloud specific instructions` section to AGENTS.md with service overview, env var setup (including `.env` creation from Cursor Secrets), run commands, lint/build/test info, and gotchas for future cloud agents. - Include nginx reverse proxy instructions and Keycloak test credential references. [keycloak_login_and_dashboard.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-b76736ea-aaf5-45ff-a758-8d6326cf6618/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fkeycloak_login_and_dashboard.mp4) [Authenticated dashboard](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-b76736ea-aaf5-45ff-a758-8d6326cf6618/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fauthenticated_dashboard.webp) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
